verdict.rationale: Claude Design documents export to PPTX, PDF, and HTML, and a community user confirms SVG export exists, though it strips animations during sanitizing. Nothing in the evidence shows the asset-production controls the story centers on. missing for 10: PNG export, per-layer export presets, scale multipliers (1x/2x/3x), slices, and independent hands-on corroboration of export fidelity.

support.subject: As a designer, I can export production assets — PNG, SVG, PDF, and more — with per-layer presets, scales, and slices

citations.quote: Export to PPTX, PDF, or HTML, share an org-scoped link, hand off to Claude Code, or send to the apps you already use daily.
Whatever tool prepares the SVG for export in Claude Design will strip animations as part of a sanitizing process
